name: noisesmith
description: Describe a sound in plain words and get an audio file saved on your computer.
long_description: NoiseSmith turns a text description ("an old creaky door", "wind from a breeze to a hurricane") into a sound-effect file. Early development: it can make wind, rain, thunder, whooshes, door and floor creaks, impacts and game blips, plus optional realistic AI sounds (animals) with your own ElevenLabs key. Sounds are free to use anywhere (CC0).

tools.name: create_sound
tools.description: Create a sound effect (wind, rain, thunder, whoosh, door and floor creaks, impact, game blips) and save it as WAV, FLAC, OGG or MP3, optionally looped.

tools.name: mix_sounds
tools.description: Layer several sounds into one scene (a storm, a street) with volume, timing and repeats, optionally as a seamless loop.

tools.name: export_sound
tools.description: Convert a sound file to WAV, FLAC, OGG or MP3, matching a loudness target for games, the web or broadcast.

tools.name: make_loop
tools.description: Turn an existing sound file into a seamless loop.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List the available sound recipes and what their settings mean.

tools.name: preview_sound
tools.description: Play a saved sound through the speakers.

tools.name: create_ai_sound
tools.description: Create a realistic sound (animals, crowds) with ElevenLabs AI, using your own key. Costs credits on your account.

tools.name: ai_status
tools.description: Check whether AI sounds are set up, your plan and credits left.

output_dir.title: Sounds folder
output_dir.description: The folder where NoiseSmith saves the sounds it creates.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Only needed for realistic AI sounds such as animals. Your own key from elevenlabs.io; sounds are billed to your account. Leave empty to use only the free built-in sounds.
